caseName: Konigsberg v. State Bar of California
caseNameFull: Konigsberg v. State Bar of California
attorneys: Edward Mosk and Samuel Rosenwein for petitioner., Frank B. Belcher and Ralph E. Lewis for respondents. A. L. Wirin and Hugh R. Manes for the American Civil Liberties Union of Southern California.

opinions.text: Motion to use record in No. 5, October Term, 1956, granted. Motion of American Civil Liberties Union of Southern California for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of California granted.
